versions.name: Camp Horseshoe

features.note: Many camp facilities are wheelchair accessible.
A natural amphitheatre at The Bend fire circle.
A chapel used for a sunrise service.
A three-to-four-week counsellor-in-training programme for ages fourteen and fifteen.
A ropes course, aerial obstacles, and a vertical playground.
The Trailblazer first-year camper program.
Craft projects, plaques, and industrial arts.
Guided rides across miles of camp trails.
A rare computer museum in the STEAM centre.
Roberts Lodge holds exhibits, displays, and a turtle tank.
A camp-wide outpost overnight midweek.
The dining hall closes on outpost day and troops cook in their sites.
A pistol marksmanship program for Scouts fifteen and older.
The Charles Heistand Memorial Pool.
Provisional campers are paired with a host troop.
A thirty-five-foot rappelling tower.
An athletic field used for sports and athletics.
A STEAM centre in Schramm Lodge.
Boat docks on the Octoraro Creek.
A three-hundred-foot zip line.

versions.summary: Chester County Council's Scouts BSA resident camp at Horseshoe Scout Reservation, located in Rising Sun, Maryland.

sources.citation: coordinate geocoded from street address (US Census / OpenStreetMap), 2026-07-22

provenance.notes: Coordinate refined 2026-07-22 from the camp's street address (was a city/state-centroid approximation). Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/539-101949); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
